_description: General on-screen text for the game. 'start' = the first screen (needed so the browser allows sound): 'prompt' is the main line, 'soundNote' the smaller line under it; 'noiseWarningTitle' and 'noiseWarning' fill the warning box about loud sounds (leave "" to hide it). 'title' = the opening page: 'heading' is the big game name, 'tagline' is an optional line under it (leave "" to hide), 'enterButton' is the button label, 'hint' is the small text under the button. 'sequence' = the intro slides: 'nextHint' is the small text in the caption box telling players how to continue, 'backButton' is the label of the button that goes to the previous slide. 'popup' = pop-up windows: 'continueButton' is the default closing button label. 'map' = the game map: 'interactHint' shows above a '!' when Alex is close, 'progress' is the counter in the corner ({read} and {total} become numbers); 'talkHint' shows above a person Alex can talk to; after 'hintAfterSeconds' seconds without finding anything new, an arrow next to Alex points toward something unread, labeled 'hintLabel' (0 turns hints off). 'reset' = the Reset button in the game's top-right corner: 'confirm' is the note shown after the first click (a second click clears all progress and returns to the title screen). 'chat' = conversations with people: 'alexName' is the name under Alex's face, 'skipHint' the small note shown while the conversation plays.
_usedIn: Simulation page → Start screen, Title screen (opening page), Intro slides, Pop-ups, Game map

start._location: Very first screen, dark background, before the opening page

start.noiseWarning: This simulation plays loud, unpleasant sounds: a data center's constant roar, construction noise and coughing. Please start with your volume low. You can mute at any time with the speaker button or the M key.

reset.confirm: Click again to reset all progress
